entry_item.definition: a) v t. and I, To finish, end, terminate; to expire.b) v.t. To squander, waste, dissipate, destroy; to consume; to hurt, damage.c) v.i. To die.d) v, aux. (with gerund) indicating completion of an action.

example.definition: Unexhausted, inexhaustible; (With instr. =- yly baram) not only, but also, even.
To exhaust all means, be at wit's end.
For a business or job to come to an end.
To squander or waste one's possessions.
To eat up, consume, waste complete1y (property, etc.).
To wear out or damage one's clothes.
